name: Kururi Kiyomasa
source:
Kukuri Estate Head.

Deceased.
Former chairman of Kukuri Pharmaceuticals. He left behind a vast inheritance. There is no doubt about his death, and murder seems unlikely. The will outlining his inheritance is currently held by Kishiru Inugami. [spoiler]The inheritance conditions written in his will are ominous... There are suspicions he was secretly manufacturing tobacco in the greenhouse and selling it to heretics.

He was worried about his sons getting the inheritance after his death. He appeared to hold a deep appreciation for Mizuno. A hidden lab in the greenhouse basement was used to manufacture "Virus", using tobacco as the base. The refined "Virus" was illicitly sold by Miyabi.

Culprit of the serial murders at the Kukuri estate. Three victims died by traps Kiyomasa had set in advance. The traps were meant to test whether the four inheritance candidates were worthy of inheriting his estate.

In truth, Kiyomasa was being manipulated by Inugami. It was all part of Inugami's scheme to purge the Kukuri family's shady dealings. However, when Kiyomasa, with his worsening illness, used "Virus" on himself, the plan unraveled — or, perhaps it was fate. The Kukuri family, thriving on drug dealing, was already ensnared by Death.[/spoiler]

[From in-game suspect profile]
